Raghav Juyal's relationship status and new film poster generate buzz

Actor and dancer Raghav Juyal is facing renewed speculation about his love life following the viral circulation of photos with co-star Niharika NM. While some reports suggest a romantic link, other coverage indicates the photos may be a promotional tease for Juyal's upcoming film, "Bhai Tera Star Hai." Juyal has shared a poster for this new project, which Niharika has also reacted to, further fueling discussion.
